boundedQuestion: Does the installed tender-lining execution gate consume the declared authority module, parameters, freeze, and current-wall dependency identities before accepting the material binding?

falsifiableTrial.positiveControl: The pristine binding passes validateLiningBinding with the installed enclosure member and canonical component/view IDs.
falsifiableTrial.expectedFailClosedResult: Reject before accepting the lining binding because declared authority identities do not match delivered bytes.

candidateRuleDelta.verifierGate: Every declared authority hash that supports a current-binding claim must be recomputed from the delivered or exactly materialized byte resource and compared by the actual pre-use verifier. Hash-shaped metadata and an outer receipt hash do not establish transitive authority identity.

boundaries: Does not reject the packaged lining geometry, material mask, source interpretation, shader pixels, or the exact pristine package bytes.
Does not claim that the packaged wall dependency bytes are wrong; all three delivered wall resources match WALL_AUTHORITY_BINDING.json.
Does not establish browser, device, production, Mother, or user acceptance.

The packaged ui-protocol.test.mjs was not used as a full-runtime positive control because the pristine package currently fails an unrelated draw-count assertion (actual 0, expected 673); this result is limited to the exact installed binding consumer.
